subtitle: Lesson 23 · Cost Optimization for AI and GPU Workloads

code:
Training must hold, at once:
  parameters
  + optimizer state   (e.g. Adam: ~2x params)
  + retained activations (needed for backprop)
  + gradients          (~1x params)

Inference only needs:
  parameters
  + activations for the current request
caption: Same model, very different GPU memory requirement depending on which job it is.
